decisions.reason: As an incremental modular successor to an already accepted trommel screen, it sits directly in the firm's existing screening knowledge base and can be improved through established customer feedback and service routines.

The mobile high-speed flail shredder line is closely related to the firm's core mobile shredding capabilities, so the firm has strong absorptive capacity to learn from field use and continue refining it commercially.

The mobile high-speed grinder remains near the firm's established recycling machinery competences, but somewhat thinner visible market evidence and possible portfolio overlap keep withdrawal risk moderately higher than for the strongest core lines.

This green-waste grinder still fits the firm's grinder know-how and customer base, yet its narrower application and overlap with other grinder models make it the most exposed line if sales or differentiation are disappointing.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are strongly aligned with the firm's long-standing shredding expertise and stationary plant business, giving it a solid basis to assimilate operating experience and sustain the line.
